input.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion obligation after the Termination section
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement gives us no exit rights: TrueLink has no obligation to help us migrate or to return our data on termination, and Section 13 only makes us responsible for finding new hosting. We have added a standard transition clause requiring up to six months of assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data in machine-readable form within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance if that is easier operationally.

ops.text: 14a. TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content and all other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control, including borrower and loan data, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.
